name: sense_bodies_transparent
about: An NPC standing between does not block sight (0018/6). NPCInit (0x10273394) makes every NPC m_bNPCTransparent (+0xfc) and CTraceFilterFVisible::ShouldHitEntity 0x10107630 skips those, so FVisible slot 201 (0x102b4630, mask 0x2804091) sees through a body; only the player and solid props block (StandardFilterRules 0x101d3080; conditions-and-states.md 'CAI_BaseNPC::GatherEnemyConditions -- 0x10270b20', recovered 2026-09-29). Guard at (384, -393.7) Source units facing +Y, D_HT 5, npc_perception 3 (440 units); a neutral bystander stands on the line at 150 units, the standing player behind it at 300 units: the guard sees the player at once -- SEE_PLAYER 0x5a, SEE_HATE 0x43, NEW_ENEMY 0x54 -- and goes to COMBAT (0x102ad660 case 1). The block's half is sense_cone_enter (the block hides the player until he clears its corner).
